data.long_meaning: From the Arabic word 'furuj', which means 'light' or 'radiant'. In Islamic tradition, Furjah symbolizes the light of faith and guidance from Allah. The name Furjah carries the meaning “Light, radiant” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Furjah usually hope their child will grow to embody light, radiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of spiritual enlightenment and divine guidance.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Furjah total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Furjah holds a rich cultural significance as it is derived from the Arabic language, which is the language of the Quran and Hadiths, the holy texts of Islam. This name is often used in the Islamic world, reminding us of the importance of knowledge and wisdom, as 'furuj' means 'light'.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Furjah cannot be overlooked, according to Islamic teachings. It symbolizes the inner light of faith and guidance that Allah grants to every believer. The name serves as a reminder that just as light illuminates the darkness, faith illuminates the heart and provides guidance through the challenges of life. Additionally, Furjah is believed to be a source of blessings, as the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) is reported to have said, "Allah’s curse is upon the one whom Allah has not guided and upon the one whom He has guided and he denies it." (Bukhari and Muslim)
